item.title: Philpot drops 39 to lead Troup past Upson-Lee on senior night
item.description: The Tigers are scorching hot. item.title: Troup outlasts Upson-Lee rally on senior night
item.description: The Troup boys basketball team put together a wire-to-wire win on senior night, edging out Upson-Lee 66-61. It was a big region win for the Tigers, who lost to the Knights on the road earlier in the season. It looked like the Tigers would run away with the game early when they scored the opening 11 points of the game. item.title: Wildcat 5K to return to Lanett
item.description: Springwood’s Wildcat 5K Color Run and 1 Mile Fun Run return March 21 in Lanett, raising funds for athletics while inviting the community onto campus for a colorful morning of racing.

item.title: Mitchell pushes back on LaGrange SPLOST camera plan
item.description: LaGrange Councilman Mark Mitchell challenges using SPLOST camera funds for in-car systems instead of 24/7 fixed readers, prompting a correction to council minutes to record his objection.

item.title: Hogansville mulls moratorium for data centers
item.description: Hogansville weighs new zoning rules and a possible short-term moratorium on data centers, including cryptomining sites, with a key vote set for Feb. 2.

item.title: How Are Child Custody and Parenting Time Determined?
item.description: Whenever a couple goes through a marital or domestic dissolution, who gets the custody of the children and how their parenting and visitation times are determined are the most contested parts of the divorce, besides asset division.
